annotations.title: Invoice Number Gap and Duplicate Check

description: Check a run of invoice numbers for gaps and duplicates. Send the invoice numbers (up to 200, for example INV-0001, INV-0002, INV-0004) and the prefix in front of the counter (for example INV-; leave out when the numbers are digits only). Optionally the first and last counter you expect, to catch numbers missing at either end. Get back the missing numbers by range (first, last, how many), every counter used more than once with the forms seen, and any number that does not fit the prefix-plus-counter form. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/invoice-number-sequence). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

expected_first.description: Optional: the first counter the series should start at (for example 1).

expected_last.description: Optional: the last counter the series should reach.

label.description: Optional label for the series (your own text, echoed back; not a person).

numbers.description: The invoice numbers to check (up to 200; any order).

items.description: An invoice number, for example INV-0042.

prefix.description: Text in front of the counter, for example INV- or 2026/ (matched without regard to case). Leave out for digits-only numbers.

name: invoice_number_sequence
